notes:
ISS2000 PC Port NC 1.0.2 - 9 November 2026

What's new since 1.0.1:
- Custom menu backgrounds: the first time you start the game, the menu backgrounds are saved
  as PNG files in the "backgrounds" folder. Edit them with any image editor: one file changes
  every menu that uses it.
- Live reload: change a flag or a background while the game is running and you will see it
  straight away, no restart needed.
- Smoother matches: fewer short hitches when the game briefly loses its frame rhythm.
- Better reports: "Collect report" now records the real frame rate and timing, so stutter
  problems are easier to track down.
